_note: Ask FINN retrieval test. Each question is phrased as an investor would ask it. Its answer pages are the pages whose text matches `evidence`, a pattern for the answer's own wording (not the question's), checked by hand against the documents when the set was written (16 Nov 2026). `words` says whether the question shares the documents' vocabulary ('same') or uses an investor's ('different'). A question is found when one of its answer pages is among the pages Ask FINN sends the model (top 8). `set`: 'tuning' questions were used to write qa.SYNONYMS; 'held-out' ones were written after it and never used to change it.
